verdict.rationale: 1Password's own support docs describe using 1Password on Apple Watch to quickly look up information, explicitly including one-time passwords, so users can read their codes from the watch without their phone. The evidence covers only Apple Watch and consists of short first-party snippets. Missing for 10: support for other smartwatch platforms (e.g. Wear OS), detail on setup and offline or standalone watch behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone

citations.quote: Use 1Password on your Apple Watch to quickly look up information: credit card numbers and PINs, one-time passwords
Learn how to view passwords and other information on your Apple Watch.
